description: Create the core application architecture: Application class, Hilt setup, Room database, data models, repositories, and the navigation framework. This establishes the foundation that all features build upon.
steps: Create data models in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/data/model/: TajweedRule.kt (id, name, nameUz, description, arabicExample, explanation, audioUrl, category), UserProgress.kt (id, ruleId, lessonCompleted, practiceScore, lastPracticeDate, totalAttempts, successfulAttempts), RecordingResult.kt (id, ruleId, audioPath, transcription, score, errors, timestamp), PracticeSession.kt, QuranAyah.kt (id, surahNumber, surahName, surahNameUz, ayahNumber, arabicText, transliterationUz, translationUz, tajweedRuleIds, page)

Create Room database in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/data/local/: TajweedDatabase.kt (entities: TajweedRule, UserProgress, RecordingResult), TajweedRuleDao.kt, UserProgressDao.kt, RecordingResultDao.kt with proper queries
Create Room type converters in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/data/local/Converters.kt for List<String> and Date types
Create repository interfaces and implementations in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/data/repository/: TajweedRepository.kt, ProgressRepository.kt, RecordingRepository.kt
Create Hilt DI modules in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/di/: AppModule.kt (provides Room DB, DAOs, Retrofit), RepositoryModule.kt (binds repository implementations)
Create navigation in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/navigation/: Screen.kt (sealed class with all routes), NavGraph.kt (NavHost with all destinations)
Create app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/MainActivity.kt with @AndroidEntryPoint, Compose setup, and navigation host
Create Firebase configuration placeholder at app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/data/remote/FirebaseService.kt for Firestore operations

Create OpenAI Whisper API service in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/data/remote/: WhisperApiService.kt (Retrofit interface), WhisperRepository.kt (handles audio upload and transcription response)

Create utility classes in app/src/main/java/com/tajweed/ustoz/util/: AudioRecorder.kt (MediaRecorder wrapper), TajweedAnalyzer.kt (compares transcription with expected text, identifies errors), Constants.kt
acceptance_criteria: All data models are defined as Room entities with proper annotations
Room database class references all entities and DAOs
DAOs have CRUD operations with Flow-based queries
Repositories provide clean API over DAOs and remote services
Navigation graph has routes for: Home, Lessons List, Lesson Detail, Quran, Quran Reader, Practice, Recording, Progress, Settings
MainActivity sets up Compose with Material3 theme and navigation
WhisperApiService defines the multipart upload endpoint
AudioRecorder wraps MediaRecorder with start/stop/save functionality
verification: Verify all Kotlin files compile-check by examining import consistency and annotation usage
Verify DAOs have @Dao annotation and proper query annotations
Verify Hilt modules have @Module and @InstallIn annotations
Verify navigation routes cover all app screens
findings: All 32 Kotlin source files created successfully. Cannot run Gradle build due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. File structure, imports, and annotations verified manually. Added TajweedUstodTheme in ui/theme/ package (needed by MainActivity). AudioRecorder takes Context parameter for API 31+ MediaRecorder constructor. Navigation uses query parameter pattern for optional ayahId in Recording screen. Qur'on betlari (pages) QuranAyah modelida 'page' field sifatida qo'shilgan.
